_doc: Gate policy as DATA (law 1/2). Read by gate-runner (staging) and candidate.sh (classification) from the ACCEPTED copy only. gate_paths: everything root may run or install from the super-repo glue (scripts/substrate) plus the harness the gate judges with (validation/scripts); a candidate touching one is shadow-evaluated and installed/run only after promotion. non_root_paths: an EXPLICIT exclusion list of files no unit, entrypoint, pull-sync or image install runs (host-only operator tools); MANIFEST.gate_paths carries them '!'-prefixed. A candidate may only ADD gate_paths and only REMOVE non_root_paths; the reverse is a widening. fixture_paths: the accepted corpus; a candidate may ADD (ordinary), any other status is a widening (H2). soak_ticks: consecutive passing shadow ticks before promote.request. canary_order: root-code rollout order (H5), informational for P. Globs: shell case patterns, '*' crosses '/'.
